lesson.title: 4.1 Rooms at Home
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Recognize and name a home and five rooms, and say which room a family member is in.
lesson.grammar_function: This is the + room. The grandmother is in the kitchen. The adults are in the living room.
lesson.prerequisite: 2.1 places and in the park; 2.5 this; 1.4-1.6 family words.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say This is the kitchen. and say which room a family member is in.
